}}'''Nengar''' was a soldier from [[Shienar]].{{Ref/book|c|Nengar|Nengar}}

== Appearance ==
He shaved his topknot and was bald while following the [[Prophet]]. He had heavier build than Masema, though not stocky, just bigger. He had dark eyes. He was 5'11" or 180 cm.{{Ref||Nengar}}

== Activities ==
He is one of the twenty Shienarans picked to accompany [[Ingtar Shinowa]] and [[Rand al'Thor]] on the hunt for the [[Horn of Valere]].

He then joined [[Masema Dagar]] when Masema became the Prophet. Along with [[Bartu]], he was one of only two Shienarans who chose to stay with Masema in [[Samara]]. They truly believed in Masema.{{ref/book|5|38}}{{ref/book|5|40}}

He was part of the [[Dragonsworn]] army that pursued the [[Shaido]] with [[Perrin Aybara]]. He was with Masema when he met with Perrin and reported a large quantity of grain found in [[So Habor]].{{Ref/book|10|7}}

Masema left Nengar in charge of his army when he repositioned himself to be close to Perrin during the [[Battle of Malden]].{{ref/book|11|29}}

Nengar was killed by [[Cha Faile]] prior to the [[Last Battle]] at the same time as Masema.{{ref||Nengar}}{{ref/book|12|p}}
